text:
Cole Caufield scored in overtime on Thursday to beat Utah, and the headlines did the rest: his 15th career overtime goal, the fastest anyone has reached that number. Jakub Dobes was quoted by Montreal Hockey Fanatics: "It's ridiculous". Caufield has 11 goals in 16 games and ranks fifth in the league in our wins added.

The finishing is running hot, though not wildly so. He is shooting 20.4%, the same rate as last season's 51-goal year, but our likely range for his true talent sits nearer 17%. Eleven goals on 6.9 expected is the gap. The team is also scoring more than expected with him on, and at five on five Montreal actually controls less of the play with him than without him this year.

None of that means he is a fluke. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting to the slot more than almost any forward last season (97th percentile), and Evolving-Hockey had him facing the toughest competition there is. Expect fewer goals per shot and plenty of shots. Our projection: about 46.
headline: Caufield has made overtime his personal space
